en.title: Anthony Mackie Reveals Chris Evans Secretly Gave Him the Endgame Script
en.summary: Anthony Mackie shares a deeply personal moment from the set of Avengers: Endgame, detailing how his close friend Chris Evans provided him with an early script. This allowed Mackie to discover his character's pivotal transformation into Captain America before anyone else.
en.body:
The bond between **Chris Evans** and **Anthony Mackie** extends far beyond their on-screen partnership as Captain America and Falcon. Their friendship, forged over years of filming within the Marvel Cinematic Universe, reached a touching peak during the production of **Avengers: Endgame**. Mackie recently revealed that Evans, his trusted confidant, went to extraordinary lengths to share a pivotal moment of his character's journey.

In a heartwarming display of camaraderie, Evans provided Mackie with an early copy of the **Avengers: Endgame** script. This wasn't just about sharing a plot point; it was about allowing Mackie to experience the emotional arc of his character, Sam Wilson, taking on the mantle of Captain America, at the same time Evans himself was grappling with the conclusion of his own iconic run as Steve Rogers. The act underscores the deep trust and mutual respect between the two actors, who became like family during their shared tenure in the superhero saga.

## A Moment of Truth

Mackie described the experience of reading the script, gifted by his friend, as profoundly moving. It was during this private reading that he learned the specifics of how Sam Wilson would ultimately inherit the shield and the title of Captain America, a moment that resonated deeply with him. This early access allowed Mackie to internalize the significance of the transition, preparing him for the emotional weight of portraying the new Cap.

> "Chris Evans is somebody who I hold near and dear," Mackie shared, emphasizing the personal nature of this gesture. "He’s been in the trenches with me. He’s been through the wringer with me. He’s seen me at my best and my worst. He’s one of those guys that you’re like, man, I’m so glad I met this person."

This intimate sharing of a character's destiny highlights the human element within the blockbuster machine. While audiences see the grand spectacle on screen, the actors experience the journey with all its personal highs and lows, often leaning on each other for support.

## Fan Reactions and the Future of the Shield

Fans have long cherished the dynamic between **Captain America** and **Falcon**, and the moment Sam Wilson officially became Captain America in **The Falcon and The Winter Soldier** was a culmination many had eagerly anticipated. Mackie's revelation adds another layer of appreciation for the actors' personal investment in their roles and their genuine connection off-screen. The idea that Evans played a role, even by sharing the script, in preparing Mackie for this monumental shift deepens the emotional resonance for the fanbase. It speaks to a shared history and a passing of the torch that felt earned both in-universe and, in a way, between the actors themselves.

## What's Next for Captain America

With **Anthony Mackie** now firmly established as the MCU's Captain America, anticipation is high for his future outings. He is set to star in the upcoming film **Captain America: Brave New World**, scheduled for release in February 2025. This film will explore Sam Wilson's journey as he navigates the complexities and challenges of being the new Captain America on a global scale.
